digest.component_or_area: CI workflows - tickets branch fetch optimization
propositions: CI ticket-store full checkouts transfer 1.04–6.73 GiB and require 59–403 seconds; blob:none filtered fetches reduce transfers to 22–68 MiB and runtime to 3.6–14.3 seconds
actions/checkout and Gerrit verify-identity must apply --filter=blob:none to all tickets-branch fetches while preserving fetch-depth: 0 and credential/ref inputs
Production guards must enforce pack-size thresholds (102400 KiB standalone, 131072 KiB Gerrit materialized) via parsed git count-objects -v immediately after fetch and materialization

Git daemon fixture with uploadpack.allowFilter=true and GIT_TRACE_PACKET must prove server advertises filter capability, client sends filter blob:none request, and known historical blobs remain missing pre-materialization
Standalone and Gerrit identity jobs must snapshot exact git count-objects -v before and after materialization and verify scanning adds no promisor objects
Blobless tickets branch must reconverge independent local/remote changes with ours driver, retain all expected events, and complete merge/push successfully
